description: Search Daraz by keyword, or browse a real Daraz category. Filter by price range, rating, and sort order across the Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and Nepal storefronts.

brand.description: Only keep products whose brand exactly matches this name (case-insensitive), e.g. `Dell`, `Samsung`, `Nike`. Matched against the brand Daraz shows on the listing — leave empty to include all brands. Narrower than a dropdown because Daraz doesn't expose a fixed, query-independent brand list.
brand.title: Brand

freeShippingOnly.description: Only keep products that show a free-shipping / free-delivery badge.
freeShippingOnly.title: Free shipping only

inStockOnly.description: Only keep products Daraz currently reports as in stock.
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of products emitted.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Drop products priced above this amount (in the storefront's local currency).
maxPrice.title: Max price

minPrice.description: Drop products priced below this amount (in the storefront's local currency).
minPrice.title: Min price

minRating.description: Only include products with at least this star rating.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: What to fetch: search by keyword, or browse a category listing.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Daraz's product-listing API accepts plain datacenter traffic, so the free AUTO group is sufficient. Left on by default for IP diversity across large runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword (mode=search). Also used to narrow results within a category when mode=category.
searchQuery.title: Search query

shippedFrom.description: Only keep products shipped from this region (case-insensitive exact match), e.g. `Punjab`, `Sindh`, `Local`, `Overseas` (Pakistan); `Dhaka`, `Chattogram` (Bangladesh); `Western`, `Southern` (Sri Lanka); `Bagmati Province` (Nepal). Matches Daraz's own "Shipped From" filter — leave empty to include all regions.
shippedFrom.title: Shipped from

sortBy.description: Result ordering, matching Daraz's own sort options.
sortBy.title: Sort order

title: Daraz Scraper Input
